Kaggle data card displays CC0 1.0. Preview shows customer name/email/age/gender, product, purchase date, ticket type/subject/description/status/resolution/priority/channel/response times/satisfaction. Descriptions include unresolved {product_purchased} placeholders and templated boilerplate; privacy and semantic label quality require full local audit. Do not enable yet.

Kaggle page displays Database Contents License (DbCL) 1.0. Preview has same row count, column count, file size and matching first sample rows as Suraj520; likely re-upload/mirror, not independently confirmed byte-identical. DbCL requires compliance with ODbL and does not itself settle database rights; Kaggle page did not expose a clear companion ODbL notice. Do not ingest separately pending source/rights and hash comparison.
